definitions.gloss: early summer, the beginning of summer
definitions.explanation: The period at the start of summer, typically May to early June in Japan, when the weather begins to warm noticeably.

examples.japanese: {初夏|しょか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心地|ここち}よい→心地よい：12515_kokochiyoi⟧。
examples.english: The early summer breeze feels pleasant.

examples.japanese: {初夏|しょか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{新緑|しんりょく}→新緑：12724_shinryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まぶしい→まぶしい：03737_mabushii⟧。
examples.english: When early summer comes, the fresh green foliage is dazzling.

examples.japanese: {初夏|しょか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}、⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧お⟦{過|す}ごし→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧でしょう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: In this early summer season, how are you all doing?

notes:
Compound of ⟦{初|しょ}→初〜：03955_sho⟧ (first, beginning) + {夏|か} (summer). Refers to roughly May through early June in the Japanese calendar.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初夏|しょか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう} (the early summer season — seasonal greeting)
- {初夏|しょか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧ (early summer sunlight)
- {初夏|しょか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (early summer breeze)
- {初夏|しょか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}わせる→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{陽気|ようき}→陽気：03657_youki⟧ (weather reminiscent of early summer)

SEASONAL CONTEXT:
In Japan, {初夏|しょか} falls before the rainy season (⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧), making it one of the most comfortable times of year. It is often associated with ⟦{新緑|しんりょく}→新緑：12724_shinryoku⟧ (fresh green leaves) and clear skies. The expression {初夏|しょか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう} is used in formal letters as a seasonal greeting.
